brief:
Gaza's Health Ministry said hospitals in the territory received 7 dead over the past 48 hours, including 6 newly killed and one person who died from earlier wounds, along with 38 injured, Shehab Wire reported.

The figures represent the latest toll from ongoing violence in the enclave, where the Health Ministry regularly documents casualties treated at medical facilities across Gaza.

title: Gaza health ministry reports 7 dead, 38 wounded in 48 hours
